_comment: Accepted-risk exceptions for the `node scripts/npm-audit-ci.mjs` CI gate (replaces bare `npm audit --audit-level=high`, which can never pass while these unfixable transitive advisories exist). Every entry MUST carry an expiry — the gate fails on expired entries to force re-review. List advisories by GHSA id (stable across versions); the gate fails closed on ANY unlisted high/critical advisory.

exceptions.reason: Install-time only: extracts the tfjs-node prebuilt libtensorflow binary during `npm ci`. Zero require/import in backend/, api/, frontend/src, rag_pipeline/, scripts/ (audit-verified). No non-breaking fix exists (fixAvailable isSemVerMajor). Re-evaluate on tfjs-node upgrade.

Install-time only: used by the tfjs-node install toolchain. Zero require/import in backend/, api/, frontend/src, rag_pipeline/, scripts/ (audit-verified). No non-breaking fix exists. Re-evaluate on tfjs-node upgrade.

Install-time only (see GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85): adm-zip is used by the tfjs-node installer to unpack the prebuilt libtensorflow archive during `npm ci`, and is never required/imported by backend/, api/, frontend/src, rag_pipeline/ or scripts/ (re-verified 2026-09-19 with `npm ls adm-zip --omit=dev`). The advisory is a decompression DoS on a crafted ZIP, so exploitation needs an attacker-controlled archive handed to the installer — the installer only fetches storage.googleapis.com/tensorflow/libtensorflow over HTTPS. `npm audit` reports no non-breaking fix (fixAvailable is isSemVerMajor to tfjs-node 0.1.11, i.e. not a fix). Published 2026-09 after the last exception review; expiry aligned with the existing adm-zip/tar batch so the whole install-toolchain set is re-reviewed on one date.
